svg.title: Shells
svg.desc: Two side-on scatter plots of young particles. When every birth of a step happens at the step's end the fountain comes out in horizontal shells about 11.7 cm apart; spreading births through the step removes them. Lumpiness 0.912 against 0.213.
svg.text: The first 0.4 s of flight, side on (x across, height up), for a fountain whose speeds span 6.9 to 7 m/s.
every birth at the step's end
With speeds over 4 to 7 m/s the two measure 0.232 and 0.221: a step's births spread 3 m/s apart smear the shells by themselves.
